tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile, time
replacements = {
    'LoadInput': 'ReadRequest',
    'CheckInput': 'ValidateRequest',
    'NormalizeValue': 'CanonicalizeValue',
    'MapFields': 'ProjectFields',
    'RouteValue': 'DispatchValue',
}
for path in sorted(Path('pipeline').glob('*.go')):
    if path.name.endswith('_test.go'):
        continue
    original = path.read_text()
    updated = original
    for old, new in replacements.items():
        updated = updated.replace(old, new)
    if updated == original:
        continue
    fd, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=path.name + '.', dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
            f.write(updated)
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())
        old_mtime = path.stat().st_mtime_ns
        os.replace(temp_name, path)
        new_ns = max(time.time_ns(), old_mtime + 1_000_000)
        os.utime(path, ns=(new_ns, new_ns))
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temp_name):
            os.unlink(temp_name)
PY
rg -n 'LoadInput|CheckInput|NormalizeValue|MapFields|RouteValue|ReadRequest|ValidateRequest|CanonicalizeValue|ProjectFields|DispatchValue' --glob '"'!rename-plan.md'"' --glob '"'!go.mod'"'"
